analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price ($72,080) vs SMA5 ($77,220)/SMA20 ($84,177)/SMA50 ($95,040): below short/mid-term trends, confirming weak phase
· Significantly below SMA100 ($102,195)/SMA200 ($101,581): diagnosing weakened long-term trend

[Momentum Indicators]

· MACD histogram trajectory (-19.1982→-398.2505): worsening, strengthening bearish trend

[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($56,330): close to 52-week low ($54,125), strong support zone
· Swing resistance ($86,835): significant distance from current price, potential for trend reversal upon breakout
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (5-day low $71,710, 20-day low $71,710): confirming sideways pattern
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.85x): lower than average trading volume, reducing confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): buy entry conditions not met due to RSI entering oversold and MACD worsening; maintaining wait-and-see.
